messages.subject: errorbarh not working
parts:
Hi

I am trying to fix the error bar on the red dot that is located along the line of a normal distribution curve. But I keep getting an error and I have no idea why. 
The distribution plot works if you hash the code line in red. 
Any help is much appreciated!


mean = 0
sd = 1 
se=0.3
(limits = c(mean - 4 * sd, mean + 4 * sd)) # creating a range vector 
engTheta <- -2
dnorm = engTheta # to get position on y -axis

(x <- seq(limits[1], limits[2], length.out = 100))
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
limits2 <- aes(xmax = x + se, xmin=x - se)

(ggplot()
  + geom_line(data.frame(x = x, y = dnorm(x, mean = mean, sd = sd)),
              mapping = aes(x = x, y = y))
  +  geom_point( data=data.frame(x=dnorm,y=dnorm(dnorm, mean,sd)), aes(x,y), color="red", size=2) #person's theta
 + geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = dnorm + se, xmin = dnorm - se))
  + scale_x_continuous(limits = limits)
  + xlab("Z-score") + ylab("Probability Density") )




Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'y' not found
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In min(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
2: In max(x, na.rm = na.rm) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf
3: In min(diff(sort(x))) : no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf


Kind regards,
Aiden

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: errorbarh not working
parts:
You may need to read up on how `aes` looks up the arguments. Since your `ggplot()` call is empty, there's nothing to plot. Be more explicit or really generalize your code. Here's one way of doing things.

In the following example geom_line() takes data from ggplot() data argument and everything else is hard coded into a specific geom.

ggplot(data.frame(x = x, y = dnorm(x, mean = mean, sd = sd)), aes(x = x, y = y))+ 
  geom_line() + # reads x and y from ggplot()
  geom_point(data=data.frame(x=dnorm,y=dnorm(dnorm, mean,sd)), aes(x,y), color="red", size=2) +
  geom_errorbarh(data = data.frame(x=dnorm,
                                   y=dnorm(dnorm, mean, sd),
xmax = dnorm + se,

xmin = dnorm - se),
                                   aes(xmax = xmax, xmin = xmin, x = x, y = y)) +

scale_x_continuous(limits = limits) +
  xlab("Z-score") + ylab("Probability Density")

Cheers,
Roman

messages.author: 6855b04443295af7
messages.subject: Re: errorbarh not working
parts:
Whoa, that is a pretty cool solution.

I manage to solve the problem by adding the x and y arguments into the geom_errorbarh as well.

+ geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = dnorm + semTheta, xmin = dnorm - semTheta, x=dnorm,y=dnorm(dnorm, mean,sd),height = .01))

And it worked. However,your solution is much more elegant. 

Thank you!
Aiden
